bounds.domain: Three logical request IDs, three initial credit units, one or two unit prices, one account and mutable plan/credential standing.
bounds.atomicity: Admission and settlement rely on the existing authoritative organization billing owner. Maps replay receipts precede provider dispatch.
bounds.progress: SettlesWhenObserved assumes each admitted request's terminal observation is weakly fair. Provider success and eventual observation are not guaranteed.

limitations: Unit prices abstract the published Google SKU prices; floating-point money arithmetic is covered by the existing billing engine, not this model.
The model does not prove transport behavior or cross-process implementation refinement. Route orchestration and actual SQLite replay/rate tests are separate checks.
Google account-wide free caps and negotiated volume discounts require invoice reconciliation. The request quote uses the published unit rate without platform markup.

assumptions: For every admitted or dispatched request, a valid terminal observation is weakly fair through finish(key).
The existing billing owner completes settlement. Provider success and eventual arrival of a terminal observation are not assumed.
